comments.author: Steven Lumos
comments.html: So how long until the p-tools are rewritten as D programs?

comments.author: ahl
comments.html: I don't think we're going to be rewriting most of the core p-tools as DTrace scripts -- pstack(1), pmap(1), and pflags(1) are really about static state analysis rather than observing dynamic behavior. However, truss(1) is a good candidate for using DTrace as its underlying instrumentation methodology; we're thinking about how to do that...
